verses.text: I love the LORD because he hears my voice when I cry for mercy.
He leaned in to listen, so I’ll call on him for as long as I live.
Death’s ropes wrapped around me. The pain of Sheol got hold of me. Trouble and grief were all I could see.
Then I called on the LORD’s name: “Please, LORD, save my life!”
The LORD is gracious and righteous. Our God is full of mercy.
The LORD protects people who don’t know how to protect themselves. I was down low, and he saved me.
You can rest again, my soul. The LORD has been so good to you.
You rescued my life from death, dried the tears in my eyes, and kept my feet from falling.
I’ll walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I kept believing, so I spoke up: “I’m going through a lot.”
In my panic I said, “Everybody lies.”
What can I give the LORD for all he’s done for me?
I’ll lift the cup of salvation and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep the promises I made to the LORD, right in front of all his people.
The death of his faithful people is precious in the LORD’s sight.
LORD, I really am your servant. I’m your servant, the son of your servant girl. You broke my chains and set me free.
I’ll bring you a sacrifice of thanks and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep the promises I made to the LORD, right in front of all his people,
in the courts of the LORD’s house, right in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
